name: OSS_BI_SNAPSHOT_PERIODS
description: This entity will have the snapshot period records in month, quarter and year.

columns.name: BI_SNAPSHOT_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Primary Key based of  Sequence

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Values: 'GM': Gregorian Month,   'GQ': Gregorian Quarter,  'GY': Gregorian Year

columns.name: PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: FK to FND_CAL_MONTH/FND_CAL_QUARTER/FND_CAL_YEAR

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Period Start Date

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: Period End Date

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period Name

columns.name: PRIOR_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Prior Period Code

columns.name: RECENT_FLAG
columns.description: Set to Y for most recent, full period, else set to N

columns.name: PARTIAL_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Set to Y for the current partial period, else N

columns.name: CALENDAR_TYPE
columns.description: Identify Fnd or Enterprise Calendar

columns.name: PERIOD_MONTH_CODE
columns.description: Period Month Code

columns.name: PERIOD_QUARTER_CODE
columns.description: Period Quarter Code

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR_CODE
columns.description: Period Year Code

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
